issues.issue: Whether the Minister may suspend processing of a citizenship application under s.13.1 of the Citizenship Act pending IRPA cessation proceedings
issues.applicant_position: Minister says s.13.1 permits suspension to await cessation results, and his interpretation is reasonable.
issues.result_quote: it follows that the Minister’s interpretation to the effect that section 13.1 of the Citizenship Act allows him to suspend the processing

issues.issue: Whether mandamus should compel the Minister to continue processing the citizenship application
issues.applicant_position: Minister says he has no public legal duty to process the application while cessation is pending, so the mandamus test is not met.
issues.respondent_position: Respondent sought mandamus compelling the Minister to continue processing his citizenship application.
issues.result_quote: The Judge’s order for mandamus cannot stand.

issues.issue: Whether solicitor-client costs for bad faith were properly awarded against the Minister
issues.applicant_position: Minister says conflicting case law existed, he acted legally, and there was no bad faith or subterfuge.
issues.result_quote: There is no basis in the record for a finding of bad faith or subterfuge.
